description: Geological data sources for the Ohio-Wabash tri-state region (IN/IL/KY): bedrock geology, surficial/glacial geology, drift thickness, soils (SSURGO), and subsurface schema.

downstreamConsumers.need: SSURGO sand/silt/clay for OpenHydroNet basin static attributes

provenanceDoctrine: STATE-BEST (published state surveys) != OBSERVED (site-verified) != DERIVED. Missing sources are UNAVAILABLE; never fabricate stratigraphy, soil properties, or borehole logs.

regionalContext.note: General published context for the tri-state anchor region (Posey County, IN and surroundings); NOT a site determination.
regionalContext.setting: Illinois Basin: Pennsylvanian-age bedrock (shale, sandstone, limestone, coal) buried under thick Quaternary glacial deposits (till, outwash, alluvium); bedrock approaches the surface in far southwestern Indiana / western Kentucky.
